mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(stat_date, '%Y-%m') AS statMonth, MAX(total_users) AS totalUsers, SUM(new_users) AS newUsers, MAX(active_users) AS activeUsers, MAX(total_docs) AS totalNotes, SUM(new_docs) AS newNotes, MAX(total_kbs) AS totalKbs, SUM(new_kbs) AS newKbs, MAX(total_comments) AS totalComments FROM daily_stat WHERE YEAR(stat_date) = #{year} GROUP BY statMonth ORDER BY statMonth

SELECT CONCAT(#{year}, '-', LPAD(#{month}, 2, '0')) AS statMonth, COALESCE(MAX(total_users), 0) AS totalUsers, COALESCE(SUM(new_users), 0) AS newUsers, COALESCE(MAX(active_users), 0) AS activeUsers, COALESCE(MAX(total_docs), 0) AS totalNotes, COALESCE(SUM(new_docs), 0) AS newNotes, COALESCE(MAX(total_kbs), 0) AS totalKbs, COALESCE(SUM(new_kbs), 0) AS newKbs, COALESCE(MAX(total_comments), 0) AS totalComments FROM daily_stat WHERE YEAR(stat_date) = #{year} AND MONTH(stat_date) = #{month}

SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.type, d.kb_id AS kbId, kb.name AS kbName, d.parent_doc_id AS parentDocId, d.creator_id AS creatorId, uc.name AS creatorName, d.last_editor_id AS lastEditorId, ue.name AS lastEditorName, d.version, d.is_public AS isPublic, CASE WHEN d.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS deleted, d.deleted_at AS deletedAt, d.audit_status AS auditStatus, d.view_count AS viewCount, d.like_count AS likeCount, d.comment_count AS commentCount, d.created_at AS createdAt, d.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM document d LEFT JOIN knowledge_base kb ON d.kb_id = kb.id AND kb.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user uc ON d.creator_id = uc.id LEFT JOIN user ue ON d.last_editor_id = ue.id WHERE d.id = #{noteId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_table (doc_id, kb_id, table_data, create_time) VALUES (#{docId}, #{kbId}, #{tableData}, NOW())
INSERT INTO kb_board (doc_id, kb_id, board_data, create_time) VALUES (#{docId}, #{kbId}, #{boardData}, NOW())
INSERT INTO kb_mind (doc_id, kb_id, mind_data, created_at) VALUES (#{docId}, #{kbId}, #{mindData}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT kb.id, kb.name, kb.description, kb.cover_url AS coverUrl, kb.creator_id AS creatorId, u.name AS creatorName, kb.is_public AS isPublic, kb.deleted AS deleted, kb.created_at AS createdAt FROM knowledge_base kb LEFT JOIN user u ON kb.creator_id = u.id WHERE kb.id = #{kbId}
SELECT kb_m.user_id AS userId, u.name, kb_m.role FROM kb_member kb_m LEFT JOIN user u ON kb_m.user_id = u.id WHERE kb_m.kb_id = #{kbId} AND kb_m.deleted = 0 -- 成员列表中排除已移除的成员
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.type, d.parent_doc_id AS parentDocId FROM document d WHERE d.kb_id = #{kbId} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.parent_doc_id, d.created_at
